entry.title: New: Bill 84 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, GRANTS AND DISBURSEMENTS FOR VISITORS INDUSTRY, TOURISM MANAGEMENT GRANT FUND" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget to delete conditional language stating the Tourism Management Grant Fund may not be used for marketing and promotion but must be used for tourism management or education efforts.
